definitions.dataset_macro_token_accuracy: arithmetic mean of dataset token accuracies
definitions.dataset_macro_f1: arithmetic mean of corrected dataset macro-F1 values
definitions.combined_expected_label_macro_f1: macro F1 over concatenated evaluated tokens using only expected gold labels
definitions.combined_union_label_macro_f1: macro F1 over concatenated evaluated tokens using the union of gold and predicted labels
definitions.combined_token_weighted_f1: weighted F1 over concatenated evaluated tokens using the union of gold and predicted labels
definitions.pooled_boundary_f1: F1 calculated after summing boundary TP, FP, and FN
